verdict.rationale: Delegated third-party filing is a fair question for a company registry, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack documents only direct filing services, identity verification and a read API, with nothing on authorised agents, designees or representatives acting for a company. Identity verification and online filing are adjacent features and do not establish a sanctioned third-party rail.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, the service documents a sanctioned third-party rail — designees, authorized providers, registered agents, or representatives — through which a provider can act for my company
